_substack_env: SUBSTACK_* variables override JSON after load. Chromium profile path: set SUBSTACK_CHROMIUM_USER_DATA_DIRECTORY in .envrc (direnv). See docs/substack-html/README.md. insert_subscribe_button_after_paste (default true): after body paste, automation opens the editor Button menu and inserts Substack Subscribe. SUBSTACK_INSERT_SUBSCRIBE_BUTTON_AFTER_PASTE=0 turns it off. paste-schedule fills the publish modal (Continue, section, tags, schedule) but never clicks final Send; finish in Substack, then make sb-mark-published. schedule_push_deliveries toggles email/app delivery.
